goal: Das bisherige Entwicklungsvorgehen auf Effizienz analysieren und einen schnelleren Agenten-Fast-Path einführen, ohne Scope-, Single-Writer-, Evidence-, Freeze- oder Gate-Qualität zu senken.

guide_delta.summary: Ein kompakter maschinengeprüfter Startkontext verhindert wiederholtes Lesen und Statusdrift. Die operative Agentenführung wird anschließend auf drei Kernrollen mit triggerbasierten Spezialisten verdichtet.

direct_dependencies: two-step iteration and single-writer protections remain mandatory
Control Plane V2 stays shadow-only and non-authoritative
README/TODO progress must remain 20 of 132 = 15.2 percent
tests_required: Step 1: new fast-context gate must reject README/TODO progress drift and preserve compact source hashes/priorities
Step 1: Iteration Gate Router must execute the fast-context check before manifest routing
Step 1: governance gate must remain green
Step 2 after green: update AGENTS.md and AGENT_ORCHESTRATION.md to Fast Path V2 without weakening safety invariants
Step 2: document observed bottlenecks, retained safeguards, trigger matrix and expected efficiency gains
Step 2: rerun targeted fast-context regression and governance gate
tests_explicitly_not_run: browser/product tests because no product runtime changes
database tests because no persistence/schema changes
full product suite because the change is governance/tooling only
risks: a speed optimization must not bypass evidence or frozen-core gates
a context cache can become dangerous if stale state is treated as current
role consolidation must preserve read-only review independence and single-writer execution
non_changes: no Control Plane V2 authority promotion
expected_side_effects: all PRs fail early on README/TODO progress drift before expensive routing work
agents can start from one compact context capsule instead of rereading several status documents
step 2 will reduce mandatory operational handoffs while keeping specialist checks trigger-based
